newsitem.title: USA: Virginia still a dead heat for Clinton, Dole.
newsitem.headline: Virginia still a dead heat for Clinton, Dole.

text.p: A new poll showed the U.S. presidential race was a statistical dead heat among Virginia voters, the Richmond Times-Dispatch reported Wednesday.

A poll conducted by WTVR and Mason-Dixon Opinion Research showed Republican Bob Dole leading President Clinton 44 percent to 43 percent. The poll has a statistical margin of error of plus or minus 3.5 percent.
The poll results were roughly the same as a Mason-Dixon poll taken two months ago and one conducted in April. All three showed Clinton and Dole in a virtual dead heat.
The latest poll was conducted Saturday through Monday and surveyed 809 Virginians, the newspaper said.
A Democratic presidential candidate has not won Virginia since Lyndon Johnson in 1964.
Neither Clinton or Dole has spent much time campaigning in the state or broadcasting television advertisements.
